rows.headline: Four of the five had ONE cause and the dispatch's hypothesis was half right: the builder does read the track registry, but only for stop conditions. The AZ path wrote a twenty-line generic stub while the committed guide was seventy-four hand-authored lines no builder produced, so nothing generated the page from the held records and on two questions it answered CONTRARY to them. The fifth, KNOWN_PREFILLS, is a held value the finalizer could not fit and nobody disclosed.

didEachFindingReproduceAtHEAD.FEE_AND_WAIVER: REPRODUCED. participant-instructions.md carried, verbatim, 'Ask the Superior Court clerk in the county above what the fee is for a petition to expunge marijuana records, and whether a fee-waiver or deferral application applies to you.' under a heading introducing it as not established in this repository, while the committed track registry states rules.fees 'none. Rule 36(a)(4) bars a filing fee.' and rules.feeWaiver 'none'. Both re-read here from data/record-clearing/legal-design-track-registry.json.
didEachFindingReproduceAtHEAD.SERVICE: REPRODUCED. The same block carried 'Ask the same clerk who must receive a copy of the petition and by what method.' while rules.service is 'none. Rule 36(b)(2) puts transmittal on the court.' and rules.notice is 'The court sends the petition to the prosecuting agency within 10 days.'
didEachFindingReproduceAtHEAD.FILING_DESTINATION: REPRODUCED. Neither half of rules.filing's 'Confirm the county-specific intake route before filing.' nor destination.detail's 'Local intake varies. Maricopa County directs arrest-only petitions to a civil petition form and a civil case number.' appeared anywhere in the guide.

rows.howKNOWN_PREFILLSWasRepairedAndWhatWasNo: vf53 named two remedies and this lane took the second: the refusal is disclosed to the participant, who is told to look at the printed line and write the value in by hand, in full, abbreviating nothing. The first remedy -- fitting the value by wrapping or continuing onto a printed second line -- was NOT taken, and the reason is a measurement rather than a preference: the write box is 11.2pt high, which is one line at the six-point readability floor this factory uses, and this lane holds no measurement of an unowned second line beneath it. Abbreviating an email address was never available: a shortened address on a sworn petition is a wrong address, not a short one. CONSEQUENCE STATED PLAINLY: no PDF byte moves, so no raster is owed, AND a verifier who holds that the value must actually be PRINTED on that line is owed a further repair which WOULD move bytes and WOULD cost this family a fresh central raster. This lane does not claim that question closed.

The guard is written against the CLAIM, not the committed wording: a hit passes only where the sentence withdraws it in terms, so a reworded relapse fails too.

A SHARED RECORD MAY NOT BE SILENTLY RE-PINNED BY A REBUILD -- this is the hazard vf57 declined to run the builder into, and it is closed rather than merely avoided. groundRecords() recomputes each pin and writes the result, asserting only that anchor STRINGS survive, so a rebuild over a drifted record would replace a stale pin with a fresh-looking one at the same moment identity-refresh.mjs correctly dropped the annotation that could have proved anything. The build now refuses where the committed receipt's pin and the bytes on disk disagree and no identityRefresh on that receipt bridges that exact transition. PROVED BY A DATA BREAK, not a code break: the manifest pin in the committed receipt was falsified to sixty-four zeroes and the builder returned status BLOCKED_SOURCE with failedSourceIdentities naming the record, its pinnedSha256 and its recomputedSha256, and composed nothing -- the overlay directory was never touched.
